title: Packaged actor facade returns current actor and rejects stale handle

verification.actor: Existing saved FOLLOWER Mankey (56), bound by full current handle, native source identity and current engine object.
verification.trigger: Call the authenticated public Inspect facade with the current handle, then with only its generation changed to a different nonzero value.
verification.observable: Current lookup returns OK and the exact current 88-byte actor state. Stale-generation lookup returns REJECTED with no actor. Both use the same authenticated facade and unchanged actor context.

setupMutations.change: Copy test.nds and test.sav into a private session and load normally. Bind the existing saved follower; no party replacement, spawn, teleport, profile or actor writes.

Use the existing shared field-return bridge with one owned guarded heap11 query/output block. Write only that block, make two Inspect calls, check each native entry/return and buffer, then free once. The deliberately stale query does not alter the actor.

limits: Native facade lookup only: controlled-action claim, not movement, normal selection, broad role identity or Scripted actor coverage.
The observation floor is one native cycle containing actual Inspect work, not completed game frames or setup padding. Current and stale calls may share a cycle.
The public state must already be initialized before Inspect. Any owner, service, buffer or identity mismatch fails; no repair is allowed.

events.value: Inspect the current handle and a stale generation through the packaged native facade.

stop.condition: Two native Inspect receipts and exact private-session cleanup, or first failure.

invariants: Current handle returns the exact live actor
